title: Phone Letter Combinations
statement:
On a telephone keypad, digits 2–9 map to letters:
2→abc, 3→def, 4→ghi, 5→jkl, 6→mno, 7→pqrs, 8→tuv, 9→wxyz

Given a string of digits, return all possible letter combinations in lexicographic order, one per line.

If the input is empty, print nothing.
inputFormat: A single line containing the digit string.
outputFormat: All letter combinations in lexicographic order, one per line.

examples.output:
ad
ae
af
bd
be
bf
cd
ce
cf

examples.explanation: Single digit 2 maps to a, b, c.

starterCode.python:
digits = input().strip()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: backtrack over each digit, appending each mapped letter
